title: Our tour guide Johnny was...
text: Our tour guide Johnny was fantastic! He was very informative and passionate about all the details of the city. We learned so much and he also gave us guidance  on the best place in Seville to visit.
author: Debbie_D

title: Mela was very...
text: Mela was very knowledgable and gave us a great overview of the city.  It was a nice chance to get some more information on great places, history & events in Seville beyond the palace and cathedral.
author: Jennifer_C

title: If this is your first...
text: If this is your first time to Sevilla, this is a great orientation to the city and its history. The guide was very open to questions and customizing the trip to meet our needs. Along the way, pointed out things to do and restaurants to try. Great tour for first timers.
author: Victoria_C

title: Seville
text:
Our guide Samuel was punctual and accurate in the information but also original in the path that made us do the city, telling us details not found in the many printed and online tourist guides.
Very helpful helped us feel at home!
Highly recommended!
author: 963gaiai

title: Walking Historic Tour of Seville
text:
We had a fantastic tour with Laura, she was so knowledgeable about her home city, we saw parts of the city, including hidden gems that we otherwise would not have seen.
Laura had a lovely personality and she had a wide vocabulary of the English language, definitely recommended
author: MartinB112

title: Nice tour of Sevilla!
text: Mila was great! She was super knowledgeable, friendly, easy to understand and on time. Thank you for a fun and informative look at Sevilla.
author: Hocawine

title: Great tour
text: Alba was great & gave us the perfect tour of the sights of Seville. She was friendly and knowledgeable. We would book again.
author: GrandTour751261

title: Great way to start a visit to Seville
text: Highly recommended.  Alba was enthusiastic and knowledgeable. We had a very helpful introduction to Seville. All our group thought Alba was great.
author: Peter T

title: Great overview with quick tour
text: Our guide Laura was so incredibly knowledgeable and friendly to boot! Super interesting information for a quick tour that packed in a lot
author: Cassandra_A

title: Clara was an exceptional guide!
text: Clara's tour of Seville was informative, engaging, and personalized. She paced the tour perfectly, sharing fascinating historical tidbits and anecdotes along the way. Clara was always happy to answer our questions and made us feel like we were old friends. Her warmth and humor created a memorable experience. We can't recommend Clara enough for anyone visiting Seville.
author: 974irajg
